treatment_summary: The plan addresses metabolic syndrome by initiating atorvastatin for lipid control, adding semaglutide for weight loss and glycaemic improvement, and starting dapagliflozin for renal and cardiovascular protection. Metformin dose is optimised pending eGFR confirmation. Existing analgesic and topical steroid regimens are continued. Monitoring includes lipid profile, HbA1c, renal function, potassium, weight, and adverse effects. Lifestyle interventions (diet, exercise, smoking cessation) are recommended per NICE CG181. All decisions await confirmation of eGFR, QRISK, pregnancy status, and infection history.
